primary_intent: Ensure that patient Rosa Delgado (DOB 1979-06-14) has exactly one AllergyIntolerance recorded for penicillin with the specified code and statuses, creating it if missing, and provide the resulting record ID/URL.
reasoning: Nitpicks: The patient detail page was not visibly opened (only the list view showed Rosa with matching DOB and ID), and the AllergyIntolerance list view does not display patient/code details on-screen. These are minor visibility/formatting issues given that the action history shows the exact JSON content used. Critical issues: None evident — no contradictions in screenshots; no wrong patient or code; no duplicate created. Critical-Point decision: SUCCESS — the agent crossed the save boundary and created the record using only provided information and the user’s permission. Outcome: The action history shows an AllergyIntolerance was created with patient reference Patient/e0a4bd34-6e6d-4a5b-9d4e-c562b2322d26 (which matches Rosa Delgado from the patient list screenshot), code SNOMED CT 91936005, criticality high, clinicalStatus active, and verificationStatus confirmed — and only those fields were set. The final AllergyIntolerance list shows one entry with ID fe75804c-2c33-4dd6-813e-13976208d3bc, which the agent reported in the correctly formatted RESULT line. No duplicates are evident. This satisfies the user’s primary intent.

items.description: Find and open the Patient record for the exact patient specified. Full credit if the agent identifies and opens the correct Patient by matching both name and date of birth. Full credit also if the Patient truly does not exist after reasonable search and the agent clearly reports this blocker. Full credit if Medplum is inaccessible/blocked (e.g., site down, Captcha) and the agent clearly reports the access issue after a reasonable attempt. Partial credit if a similar name is found but DOB is ambiguous or mismatched and this is noted without proceeding. No credit if the agent selects the wrong patient when the correct one is available.
items.justification: The agent never searched for or opened the Patient record by name/DOB. They directly used a hardcoded Patient reference (Patient/e0a4bd34-...) in the AllergyIntolerance query and in the new resource without verifying the patient's name or DOB. This fails the requirement to locate and confirm the correct Patient first.

items.criterion: Create the AllergyIntolerance with exact required fields and values, then save
items.condition: Only applies if no penicillin AllergyIntolerance exists for the patient
items.description: Create and save a new AllergyIntolerance for the patient with ONLY the specified fields set by the agent: (a) patient reference to the correct Patient, (b) code = SNOMED CT system http://snomed.info/sct, code 91936005 (Allergy to penicillin), (c) criticality = high, (d) clinicalStatus = active using system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-clinical, (e) verificationStatus = confirmed using system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-verification. Do not add extra user-entered fields beyond those required; metadata auto-added by the system is acceptable. Full credit if saved successfully with the exact required values. Full credit also if, after a reasonable attempt, the platform prevents creation/saving and the agent clearly reports this limitation instead of making unrelated changes. Partial credit for minor coding/system URI mistakes or if additional non-required fields are added due to platform constraints but the agent documents the limitation. No credit if the agent fails to save the record despite the platform allowing it, or creates multiple duplicates.
items.justification: Using the JSON tab, the agent created an AllergyIntolerance with patient reference, code SNOMED CT 91936005 (system http://snomed.info/sct), criticality high, clinicalStatus active (system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-clinical), and verificationStatus confirmed (system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-verification). The record saved successfully (ID AllergyIntolerance/fe75804c-2c33-4dd6-813e-13976208d3bc). No extraneous user-entered fields beyond the specified ones (aside from required resourceType and an allowed display within code).
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 2 shows an AllergyIntolerance resource exists with ID fe75804c-2c33-4dd6-813e-13976208d3bc. The action history shows the JSON creation with the required fields: patient reference, code (SNOMED 91936005, system http://snomed.info/sct), criticality high, clinicalStatus active (correct system), verificationStatus confirmed (correct system).
items.post_image_justification: Although the list view does not display field details, the action history confirms the resource was created with the exact required fields/values and saved successfully. Full credit.

items.criterion: Final RESULT line format and content
items.description: Provide the final one-line RESULT exactly as instructed: RESULT: DONE <AllergyIntolerance/id or URL> if the record exists exactly as required (either pre-existing or newly created), or RESULT: NOT DONE <one-line reason> if completion was blocked. Full credit for exact format with a valid id or page URL when done, or a clear one-line reason when not done (including platform access or capability limitations). Partial credit if the agent reports success but omits the id/URL, or minor format deviations while still conveying the required id/URL. No credit if the final RESULT line is missing or incorrectly declares success without evidence.
items.justification: The agent provided exactly one final RESULT line in the correct format with the resource ID: RESULT: DONE AllergyIntolerance/fe75804c-2c33-4dd6-813e-13976208d3bc.
